title: 분실물 센터: 가방을 두고 내렸어요
objective: You can tell staff where and when you left your bag, using -(으)ㄴ 것 같다.
summary: Practice reporting a bag left on the subway.
setting: A subway lost-and-found office. A passenger left a backpack on the train yesterday evening.

task.title: Report your lost item
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, fill in, put in order, or answer in Korean.

words.meaning: to leave something behind when you get off (a bus, train, taxi)
words.exampleMeaning: I left my umbrella in the taxi.
Put heavy bags up on the luggage rack.
What does the wallet you lost look like?
Is this your key? Take a look.

words.meaning: I think… (a guess). With a verb, it's about the past: 내리다 → 내린, 두다 → 둔, 놓다 → 놓은. With an adjective, it's about now: 크다 → 큰, 작다 → 작은.
words.example: 휴대폰을 식당에 놓고 온 것 같아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I think I left my phone at the restaurant.

dialogue.meaning: I left my bag on the subway yesterday.

dialogue.korean: 몇 호선을 타셨어요? 어느 역에서 내리셨어요?
dialogue.meaning: Which line did you take? Which station did you get off at?
I took Line 2. I got off at City Hall Station around 7 p.m.
What does the bag look like?

dialogue.korean: 검은색 배낭이에요. 선반 위에 놓고 내린 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: It's a black backpack. I think I left it on the luggage rack.

dialogue.korean: 잠깐만요. 어제 저녁에 비슷한 가방이 들어온 것 같아요. 이 가방이 맞아요?
dialogue.meaning: One moment. I think a similar bag came in last night. Is this your bag?

dialogue.korean: 아, 아니요. 제 가방은 더 큰 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, no. I think my bag is bigger.

exercises: Choose the correct form: 카페 의자에 지갑을 (놓고 온 / 놓고 오는) 것 같아요.
Fill in the blank with -(으)ㄴ 것 같아요 (작다): 이 우산은 제 우산보다 ____.
Choose the best reply when the staff asks 몇 호선을 타셨어요?: ① 4호선이요. ② 갈색 가방이에요. ③ 내일 연락드릴게요.
Put the words in order: 둔 / 쇼핑백을 / 의자 밑에 / 것 같아요
Answer in Korean. The staff asks 가방이 어떻게 생겼어요? Your bag is small and red (red = 빨간색, small = 작다): ____
answers: 의자 밑에 쇼핑백을 둔 것 같아요. (쇼핑백을 의자 밑에 둔 것 같아요.)
빨간색 작은 가방이에요. (작은 빨간색 가방이에요. / 작은 빨간 가방이에요. / 빨간 작은 가방이에요. / 작고 빨간 가방이에요. / 작고 빨간색 가방이에요.)
